statement.zh:
下方传输线模型由长度为 $\Delta z\ll\lambda$ 的小段组成，其电路元件参数如下：
• $l=0.3125\,\mathrm{\mu H/m}=3.125\times10^{-7}\,\mathrm{H/m}$
• $c=55.6\,\mathrm{pF/m}=5.56\times10^{-11}\,\mathrm{F/m}$
statement.en:
The transmission line model below consists of segments of length $\Delta z\ll\lambda$ and the following circuit element parameters:
• $l=0.3125\,\mathrm{\mu H/m}=3.125\times10^{-7}\,\mathrm{H/m}$
• $c=55.6\,\mathrm{pF/m}=5.56\times10^{-11}\,\mathrm{F/m}$

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 上方模型表示的传输线是有损线还是无损线？简要解释。
prompt.en: Is the transmission line that is represented by the model above a lossy transmission line or a lossless transmission line? Briefly explain.

text.zh: 先写传播常数的分布参数表达式，实部 $\alpha$ 表示衰减。
text.en: Begin with propagation constant in terms of distributed parameters; its real part $\alpha$ is attenuation.

text.zh: 逐项检查原图：只有串联电感 $l\Delta z$ 和并联电容 $c\Delta z$，没有耗散元件 $r\Delta z$ 或 $g\Delta z$。
text.en: Inspect the original cell: it contains series $l\Delta z$ and shunt $c\Delta z$, with no dissipative $r\Delta z$ or $g\Delta z$ elements.

text.zh: 把零电阻、零漏电导代入传播常数，得到纯虚数。
text.en: Insert zero resistance and conductance to obtain a purely imaginary propagation constant.

text.zh: 因此该模型是无损线；电感和电容交换储能，没有电阻性平均功率损耗。
text.en: The model is lossless: inductors and capacitors exchange stored energy with no resistive average power dissipation.

prompt.zh: 计算传输线的速度因子和特性阻抗。
prompt.en: Calculate the velocity factor and characteristic impedance of the transmission line.

text.zh: 先写原表的无损线波速、特性阻抗和速度因子定义。
text.en: Begin with the crib lossless speed, characteristic impedance and velocity-factor relations.

text.zh: 先将每单位长度参数转为 SI 单位，再代入乘积。
text.en: Convert the per-length parameters to SI units, then form their product.

text.zh: 对乘积开方后取倒数，求得波速。
text.en: Take the square root of the product and invert to obtain speed.

text.zh: 再除以真空光速，计算无量纲速度因子。
text.en: Divide by vacuum light speed for the dimensionless velocity factor.

text.zh: 独立计算 $l/c$ 的平方根，$\mathrm{H}/\mathrm{F}$ 的平方根单位是 $\Omega$。
text.en: Independently evaluate the square root of $l/c$; the square root of $\mathrm{H}/\mathrm{F}$ has units $\Omega$.

text.zh: 列出两个结果。后面的反弹图按标准答案使用舍入值 $Z_{0}\approx75\,\Omega$。
text.en: State both results. The later bounce diagram uses rounded $Z_{0}\approx75\,\Omega$, as in the official solution.

prompt.zh: 若传输线长度为 $L=60\mathrm{m}$，计算其时间延迟 $T_d$。
prompt.en: If the transmission line length is $L=60\mathrm{m}$, calculate the time delay $T_d$ of the transmission line.

text.zh: 先写传播距离与单程时间的关系，并解出 $T_d$。
text.en: Begin with propagation distance versus one-way time and solve for $T_d$.

text.zh: 将 $60\,\mathrm{m}$ 与上问未舍入的波速代入。
text.en: Substitute $60\,\mathrm{m}$ and the unrounded speed from the preceding part.

text.zh: 秒转换为纳秒，$1\,\mathrm{s}=10^{9}\,\mathrm{ns}$。
text.en: Convert seconds to nanoseconds using $1\,\mathrm{s}=10^{9}\,\mathrm{ns}$.

text.zh: 与原解采用 $\mathrm{vf}=0.8$ 的 $250\,\mathrm{ns}$ 一致到所需精度。
text.en: This agrees to the required precision with the official $250\,\mathrm{ns}$ using $\mathrm{vf}=0.8$.

prompt.zh:
现在考虑下方直流电路，其中有一个在 $t=0$ 闭合的开关，以及一根性质与第 a) 问模型规定相同的传输线。

对下方反弹图，计算下列参数：
• 所有反射系数
• 所有电压幅值
• $t=T_d$ 时的负载电压 $V_L$
• $t=2T_d$ 时的传输线输入电压 $V_{in}$
prompt.en:
Now consider the DC circuit below, which contains a switch that closes at $t=0$, and a transmission line with the same properties as specified by the model in part a).

For the bounce diagram below, calculate the following parameters:
• All reflection coefficients
• All voltage amplitudes
• The voltage at the load $V_L$ at $t=T_d$
• The voltage at the input to the transmission line $V_{in}$ at $t=2T_d$

text.zh: 先写端点反射系数、初始分压和行波反射递推式。
text.en: Begin with endpoint reflection, the launch divider and the traveling-wave recurrence.

text.zh: 沿用标准答案舍入的 $75\,\Omega$ 线路阻抗；负载为 $25\,\Omega$。
text.en: Use the official rounded line impedance of $75\,\Omega$ and the $25\,\Omega$ load.

text.zh: 源电阻同样为 $75\,\Omega$，所以返回源端的波被吸收，不再产生新正向波。
text.en: The source resistance is also $75\,\Omega$, so returning waves are absorbed without another forward wave.

text.zh: $t=0$ 时发出的第一正向电压由 $12\,\mathrm{V}$ 分压求得。
text.en: Find the first forward voltage at $t=0$ by dividing the $12\,\mathrm{V}$ source.

text.zh: 在 $T_d\approx250\,\mathrm{ns}$ 到达负载，反射电压因 $\Gamma_L<0$ 而反相。
text.en: On reaching the load at $T_d\approx250\,\mathrm{ns}$, the reflected voltage changes sign because $\Gamma_L<0$.

text.zh: 在 $2T_d\approx500\,\mathrm{ns}$ 返回源后，再乘 $\Gamma_g=0$，后续正反向行波都为零。
text.en: At $2T_d\approx500\,\mathrm{ns}$ the return reaches the source. Multiplication by $\Gamma_g=0$ makes subsequent traveling waves zero.

text.zh: 负载第一次到达时测到入射和即时反射的代数和。
text.en: At the first load arrival the measured voltage is the sum of incident and immediate reflected waves.

text.zh: 源是持续 DC，$500\,\mathrm{ns}$ 后的输入电压需计入此前已有的 $6\,\mathrm{V}$，再加返回波和新反射波。
text.en: The source is sustained DC. At $500\,\mathrm{ns}$ include the existing $6\,\mathrm{V}$ input plus the return and its new reflection.

text.zh: 所有非零幅度与端点电压都应标在反弹图上；$\Gamma_g=0$ 后没有继续传播的非零轨迹。
text.en: Label all nonzero traveling amplitudes and measured endpoint voltages; after $\Gamma_g=0$ there is no further nonzero traveling trajectory.

figureCaption.zh: 采用 $Z_{0}\approx75\,\Omega$ 的反弹图：负载反射 $-3\,\mathrm{V}$，源端匹配并吸收返回波，两个测量电压均为 $3\,\mathrm{V}$。
figureCaption.en: Bounce diagram using $Z_{0}\approx75\,\Omega$: $-3\,\mathrm{V}$ load reflection, matched-source absorption, and $3\,\mathrm{V}$ at both measured endpoints.

caption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
caption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

concept.zh: 本题从分布参数模型出发，把无损线的传播性质与直流反弹图连接起来。
concept.en: This problem connects a distributed line model to lossless propagation and a DC bounce diagram.

known.zh: 模型给出 $l=0.3125\,\mathrm{\mu H/m}$、$c=55.6\,\mathrm{pF/m}$，电缆长度为 $60\,\mathrm m$；后半题的源与负载参数见电路图。
known.en: The model supplies $l=0.3125\,\mathrm{\mu H/m}$ and $c=55.6\,\mathrm{pF/m}$ for a $60\,\mathrm m$ cable. The later circuit supplies its source and load parameters.

goal.zh: 判断线是否有损，求速度因子、特性阻抗与延迟，再计算开关闭合后的反射和指定端点电压。
goal.en: Identify loss, find velocity factor, characteristic impedance and delay, then calculate reflections and the requested endpoint voltages after switching.

approach.zh: 先确认模型包含哪些储能或耗能元件，再求线参数。反弹分析使用这些参数作为输入，并把单个行波幅值与端点叠加电压区分开。
approach.en: First identify the storage and loss elements in the model, then calculate the line parameters. Use them in the bounce diagram, distinguishing individual wave amplitudes from summed endpoint voltages.

topic.zh: 驻波 · 功率 · 反射

statement.zh:
下方电路 $\mathrm{A}$ 中的传输线遭到损坏，导致其特性阻抗在沿线某处突变。

可将上方电路 $\mathrm{A}$ 中从损坏点到负载之间的传输线替换为一个有效输入阻抗 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$，得到下方电路 $\mathrm{B}$ 所示的模型。

利用定向耦合器，已确定电路 $\mathrm{B}$ 中输入端至 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 之间的稳态正向行波电压相量为 $\widetilde V^+(z)=5e^{-j2\pi z}\,\mathrm{V}$，反向行波电压相量为 $\widetilde V^-(z)=3e^{j2\pi z}\,\mathrm{V}$。
statement.en:
The transmission line in Circuit $\mathrm{A}$ below has been damaged, resulting in an abrupt change in its characteristic impedance at a point somewhere along the transmission line.

We can model Circuit $\mathrm{A}$ above by replacing the transmission line between the point of the damage and the load by an effective input impedance $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$, as shown in Circuit $\mathrm{B}$ below.

Using a directional coupler, it has been determined that the steady-state forward-traveling voltage wave on the transmission line between its input and $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ in Circuit $\mathrm{B}$ is given by the phasor $\widetilde V^+(z)=5e^{-j2\pi z}\,\mathrm{V}$, and the backward-traveling voltage wave is given by the phasor $\widetilde V^-(z)=3e^{j2\pi z}\,\mathrm{V}$.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 写出输入端至 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 之间传输线上总电压波的时域表达式。
prompt.en: Write the expression for the total voltage wave on the transmission line between its input and $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ in the time domain.

text.zh: 先写相量取实部的定义，将正反行波相量先相加。
text.en: Begin with the real-part definition, adding forward and backward phasors first.

text.zh: 由原图的 $150\,\mathrm{MHz}$ 频率求角频率，不把相位常数 $2\pi$ 当成角频率。
text.en: Use the circuit frequency of $150\,\mathrm{MHz}$ to calculate angular frequency; do not confuse it with spatial phase constant $2\pi$.

text.zh: 将给定的 $5e^{-j2\pi z}$ 与 $3e^{j2\pi z}$ 两项完整代入。
text.en: Substitute both given terms $5e^{-j2\pi z}$ and $3e^{j2\pi z}$.

text.zh: 分别合并空间与时间指数，再用 $\operatorname{Re}(e^{j\theta})=\cos\theta$。
text.en: Combine each spatial and temporal exponent, then use $\operatorname{Re}(e^{j\theta})=\cos\theta$.

text.zh: 相量取实部使用欧拉公式：余弦是实部，正弦前带 $j$，属于虚部。对每个实数幅度分别使用这条规则，幅度原有的正负号都保留。
text.en: Use Euler's formula when taking the real part: cosine is real, while the sine term multiplied by $j$ is imaginary. Apply the rule separately to each real amplitude, retaining its original sign.

text.zh: 得到含一个正向、一个反向余弦行波的时域电压。
text.en: Obtain time-domain voltage as one forward and one backward cosine wave.

prompt.zh: 计算传输线与 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 之间的反射系数。
prompt.en: Calculate the reflection coefficient between the transmission line and $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$.

text.zh: 先写原表的电压反射系数，必须比较同一参考面上的反向与正向波。
text.en: Begin with the crib voltage reflection coefficient, comparing backward and forward waves at the same reference plane.

text.zh: 按本题采用的 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 参考面，两个给定行波系数分别为正实数 $3\,\mathrm{V}$ 与 $5\,\mathrm{V}$。
text.en: At the $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ reference plane used for this problem, the given wave coefficients are positive real $3\,\mathrm{V}$ and $5\,\mathrm{V}$.

text.zh: 代入比值，电压单位约去，相位差为零。
text.en: Form the ratio; voltage units cancel and the phase difference is zero.

text.zh: 因此反射系数为正实数，而非只知道它的模。
text.en: The reflection coefficient is therefore positive real, rather than merely having a known magnitude.

text.zh: 先写原表的驻波比公式。
text.en: Begin with the crib standing-wave-ratio formula.

text.zh: 代入 $|\Gamma|=0.6$，分别计算分子、分母。
text.en: Substitute $|\Gamma|=0.6$ and evaluate numerator and denominator separately.

text.zh: 也可直接用最大最小包络交叉核对：两幅度相加为 8，相减为 2。
text.en: Cross-check with envelope extrema: the two amplitudes sum to 8 and differ by 2.

text.zh: 驻波比是无量纲量。
text.en: The standing-wave ratio is dimensionless.

prompt.zh: 计算传输线上的最大电压。该电压与电路 $\mathrm{A}$ 未损坏时传输线上的最大电压相比如何？简要解释。
prompt.en: Calculate the maximum voltage on the transmission line. How does this voltage compare with the maximum voltage on the transmission line when Circuit $\mathrm{A}$ is undamaged? Briefly explain.

text.zh: 先写原表中的电压包络最大值：正反行波在同相位置相加。
text.en: Begin with the crib maximum voltage envelope: the traveling waves add at constructive-interference positions.

text.zh: 将测得的两个峰值幅度代入，而不是把瞬时余弦值任意相加。
text.en: Insert the two measured peak amplitudes, rather than arbitrarily adding instantaneous cosine values.

text.zh: 复数模的平方等于它与共轭数的乘积。共轭会把指数中的 $j$ 变号，逐项相乘后出现两个互为共轭的交叉项。
text.en: A complex magnitude squared equals the value times its conjugate. Conjugation changes the sign of $j$ in each exponent; expansion produces two conjugate cross terms.

steps.math: \begin{aligned}|\widetilde V(z)|^2&=(5e^{-j\beta z}+3e^{j\beta z})(5e^{j\beta z}+3e^{-j\beta z})\\&=25+15e^{-2j\beta z}+15e^{2j\beta z}+9\\&=34+15(e^{2j\beta z}+e^{-2j\beta z})\end{aligned}

text.zh: 用欧拉公式合并两个交叉项，再利用余弦的最大值为 $1$。这里 $\beta=2\pi\,\mathrm{rad/m}$，所以交叉项的相位是 $4\pi z$。
text.en: Combine the cross terms with Euler's identity and use the maximum cosine value $1$. Here $\beta=2\pi\,\mathrm{rad/m}$, so the cross-term phase is $4\pi z$.

text.zh: 未受损时负载匹配，$\Gamma=0$、反向幅度为零，最大包络仅为 $5\,\mathrm{V}$。
text.en: Before damage the load was matched, with $\Gamma=0$ and zero backward amplitude, giving only a $5\,\mathrm{V}$ maximum envelope.

text.zh: 损坏后最大电压增至原来的 1.6 倍。
text.en: After damage the maximum voltage is 1.6 times the undamaged value.

figureCaption.zh: 由原题 $5\,\mathrm{V}$ 正向和 $3\,\mathrm{V}$ 反向相量求得的驻波包络，最大值 $8\,\mathrm{V}$，最小值 $2\,\mathrm{V}$。
figureCaption.en: Standing-wave envelope computed from the stated $5\,\mathrm{V}$ forward and $3\,\mathrm{V}$ backward waves, with extrema $8\,\mathrm{V}$ and $2\,\mathrm{V}$.

prompt.zh: 计算传递给 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 的时间平均功率。该功率与电路 $\mathrm{A}$ 未损坏时传递给负载的功率相比如何？简要解释。
prompt.en: Calculate the time-average power delivered to $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$. How does this delivered power compare with the power delivered to the load when Circuit $\mathrm{A}$ is undamaged? Briefly explain.

text.zh: 先写原表的净平均功率式。题目电压相量是峰值幅度，所以分母含 2。
text.en: Begin with the crib net average-power equation. The voltage phasors are peak amplitudes, so the denominator includes two.

text.zh: 先算正向波功率，再算反射功率的大小。
text.en: Calculate forward power first and reflected-power magnitude separately.

text.zh: 反向功率朝源传播，因此送给 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 的净功率是两者之差。
text.en: Reflected power travels toward the source, so net power delivered to $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ is the difference.

text.zh: 同样代入 $\Gamma$ 的公式可核对：$1-0.6^{2}=0.64$，表示正向功率的 $64\%$ 被净接收。
text.en: Verify through $\Gamma$: $1-0.6^{2}=0.64$, so $64\%$ of forward power is accepted as net power.

text.zh: 未受损时无反射，送达功率为 $0.25\,\mathrm{W}$，因此损坏后功率下降 $36\%$。
text.en: Before damage there was no reflection and delivered power was $0.25\,\mathrm{W}$, so damage reduces it by $36\%$.

prompt.zh: 计算阻抗 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 的值。传输线的损坏使该位置的特性阻抗增大还是减小？
prompt.en: Calculate the value of the impedance $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$. Did the damage to the transmission line increase or decrease its characteristic impedance at that location?

text.zh: 先写反射系数与等效阻抗的原始关系。
text.en: Begin with the original relation between reflection coefficient and effective impedance.

text.zh: 先消分母，再把含 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 的项移到同一侧。
text.en: Clear the denominator and collect terms containing $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$.

text.zh: 提取 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 并解出它，显示反射系数如何变成阻抗。
text.en: Factor out $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ and solve, showing explicitly how reflection gives impedance.
Insert $+0.6$ and $50\,\Omega$, first evaluating the dimensionless multiplier $1.6/0.4=4$.

text.zh: 等效输入阻抗由 $50\,\Omega$ 增至 $200\,\Omega$；这就是官方简化模型中“损坏使阻抗增大”的含义。
text.en: The effective input increases from $50\,\Omega$ to $200\,\Omega$, which is the increase inferred in the official simplified model.

answerText.zh: 有效输入阻抗增大。仅由 $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ 不能唯一还原损坏段本身的局部特性阻抗；原解在其简化模型下称为增大。
answerText.en: The effective input impedance increases. $Z_{\mathrm{eff}}$ alone does not uniquely determine the damaged section’s local characteristic impedance; the official simplified model calls it an increase.

concept.zh: 本题从已测得的正、反向电压相量分析受损线上的驻波、功率和等效终端。
concept.en: This problem uses measured forward and backward voltage phasors to analyze standing waves, power and an effective termination.

known.zh: 两行波为 $\widetilde V^+=5e^{-j2\pi z}\,\mathrm V$ 与 $\widetilde V^-=3e^{j2\pi z}\,\mathrm V$，并给出 $Z_0=50\,\Omega$ 和工作频率。
known.en: The waves are $\widetilde V^+=5e^{-j2\pi z}\,\mathrm V$ and $\widetilde V^-=3e^{j2\pi z}\,\mathrm V$, with $Z_0=50\,\Omega$ and the operating frequency supplied.

goal.zh: 求时域电压、反射系数、驻波比、最大电压、净平均功率与等效阻抗，并与未损坏时比较。
goal.en: Find time-domain voltage, reflection coefficient, standing-wave ratio, maximum voltage, net average power and effective impedance, then compare with the undamaged line.

approach.zh: 先保留传播方向和相位约定，再从两行波的比值与叠加出发。功率要扣除反向波携带的功率，不能只把总电压幅值代入电阻功率式。
approach.en: Keep propagation direction and phase conventions explicit. Use the ratio and superposition of the waves, and subtract backward-wave power rather than treating total voltage magnitude as a resistor voltage.

topic.zh: 匹配性质 · 并联导纳

statement.zh:
对下列每一种情况：
1. 计算 $Z_{in}$。
2. 判断发生器电路所见的负载是否匹配。
使用传输线性质或阻抗匹配方法简要说明答案。仅依赖 $Z_{in}$ 通用数学公式的答案会被扣分。
statement.en:
In each of the cases below:
1. Calculate $Z_{in}$.
2. State whether or not the generator circuit sees a matched load.
Briefly justify your answer using a transmission line property or impedance matching method. Answers relying solely on the general mathematical equation for $Z_{in}$ will receive reduced credit.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 发生器电路通过长度为 $L=\lambda/6$、特性阻抗为 $Z_0=50\Omega$ 的传输线连接到负载。
prompt.en: The generator circuit is connected to the load via a transmission line of length $L=\lambda/6$ and characteristic impedance $Z_0=50\Omega$.

text.zh: 优先使用匹配负载的性质，而不是只代通用输入阻抗式。先检验负载反射系数。
text.en: Use the matched-load property rather than only the general impedance formula. First check load reflection.

text.zh: 原图负载和线阻抗均为 $50\,\Omega$，因此 $\Gamma_L=0$。
text.en: The original circuit has a $50\,\Omega$ load and $50\,\Omega$ line, so $\Gamma_L=0$.

text.zh: 只有正向行波时，任意位置 $V/I$ 均为 $Z_{0}$；所以 $\lambda/6$ 长度也不改变输入阻抗。
text.en: With only a forward wave, $V/I$ is $Z_{0}$ everywhere; a $\lambda/6$ length therefore leaves the input unchanged.

text.zh: 输入 $50\,\Omega$ 等于源电阻，因此是匹配的。
text.en: The $50\,\Omega$ input equals source resistance and is matched.

caption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
caption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 发生器电路通过长度为 $L=\lambda/2$、特性阻抗为 $Z_0=50\Omega$ 的传输线连接到负载。
prompt.en: The generator circuit is connected to the load via a transmission line of length $L=\lambda/2$ and characteristic impedance $Z_0=50\Omega$.

text.zh: 先写原表的半波阻抗重复性质。
text.en: Begin with the crib half-wave impedance-repeat property.

text.zh: 半波长度对应 $\beta L=\pi$，一次往返相位为 $2\pi$，输入端与负载的电压电流比重复。
text.en: A half wavelength gives $\beta L=\pi$ and round-trip phase $2\pi$, repeating the load voltage/current ratio at the input.

text.zh: 把原图 $25\,\Omega$ 负载代入，得到输入也是 $25\,\Omega$，虽然线本身的 $Z_{0}$ 为 $50\,\Omega$。
text.en: Substitute the original $25\,\Omega$ load to obtain a $25\,\Omega$ input, even though line $Z_{0}$ is $50\,\Omega$.

text.zh: 比较的是源看到的整体输入与源电阻，故本电路匹配。
text.en: Compare the whole input seen by the source with source resistance; this circuit is matched.

caption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
caption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh: 发生器电路通过长度为 $L=\lambda/4$、特性阻抗为 $Z_0=50\Omega$ 的传输线连接到负载。
prompt.en: The generator circuit is connected to the load via a transmission line of length $L=\lambda/4$ and characteristic impedance $Z_0=50\Omega$.

text.zh: 先写原表的四分之一波长阻抗反演性质。
text.en: Begin with the crib quarter-wave impedance inversion.

text.zh: 代入 $Z_{0}=50\,\Omega$、负载 $100\,\Omega$，保留平方的单位。
text.en: Substitute $Z_{0}=50\,\Omega$ and load $100\,\Omega$, retaining units in the square.

text.zh: 原图源电阻是 $25\,\Omega$，因此这段线正是匹配 $25\,\Omega$ 与 $100\,\Omega$ 的四分之一波变换线。
text.en: The circuit source is $25\,\Omega$, so the line is exactly a quarter-wave transformer between $25\,\Omega$ and $100\,\Omega$.

text.zh: 输入阻抗等于源电阻，判断为匹配。
text.en: The input equals source resistance and is matched.

caption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
caption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

prompt.zh:
发生器电路连接到特性阻抗为 $Z_0=50\Omega$ 的馈线。馈线与另外两根传输线的并联组合相连：
• 长度为 $d$、输入导纳为 $Y_d$、终端阻抗为 $Z_L$ 的传输线
• 长度为 $l$、输入导纳为 $Y_s$、终端开路的传输线
prompt.en:
The generator circuit is connected to a feedline of characteristic impedance $Z_0=50\Omega$. The feedline is connected to the parallel combination of two other transmission lines:
• a line of length $d$, input admittance $Y_d$, and terminating impedance $Z_L$
• a line of length $l$, input admittance $Y_s$, and an open-circuit termination

text.zh: 并联主线与支节共享电压，先由两支路电流相加推导导纳相加。
text.en: The parallel main line and stub share a voltage. Begin by adding branch currents to obtain admittance addition.

text.zh: 代入题给的两个有单位导纳，按实部和虚部分别相加。
text.en: Substitute both given admittances with units and add real and imaginary components separately.

text.zh: 主线感性电纳与开路支节电纳抵消，总导纳成为纯实数。
text.en: The main-line and open-stub susceptances cancel, leaving a purely real admittance.

text.zh: 导纳取倒数得到节点阻抗；西门子取倒数的单位为欧姆。
text.en: Invert admittance to obtain node impedance; reciprocal siemens are ohms.

text.zh: 节点与 $50\,\Omega$ 馈线和源匹配；匹配馈线将这个阻抗重复到源。
text.en: The node matches the $50\,\Omega$ feedline and source; the matched feedline repeats that impedance to the source.

caption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
caption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

concept.zh: 本题考查能否识别传输线的特殊性质，而不是直接套用通用输入阻抗公式。
concept.en: This problem tests recognition of line properties rather than substitution into the general input-impedance formula.

known.zh: 各电路给出终端、发生器电阻与线长，包括 $\lambda/6$、$\lambda/2$、$\lambda/4$ 及并联开路支节；线的特性阻抗为 $50\,\Omega$。
known.en: The diagrams supply terminations, source resistances and lengths including $\lambda/6$, $\lambda/2$, $\lambda/4$ and a parallel open stub. The characteristic impedance is $50\,\Omega$.

goal.zh: 分别求发生器看到的输入阻抗，并据此判断源端是否匹配。
goal.en: Find the impedance seen by the generator in each circuit and decide whether the source is matched.

approach.zh: 先检查终端是否已匹配，再识别半波重复与四分之一波变换。并联支节应先合成导纳，最后才将总输入阻抗与发生器电阻比较。
approach.en: Check for a matched termination, then recognize half-wave repetition and quarter-wave transformation. Combine a parallel stub in admittance before comparing the resulting input impedance with the source resistance.

title.zh: 利用 Smith 图的阻抗匹配
title.en: Impedance Matching with a Smith Chart

topic.zh: Smith 图 · 复数负载匹配

statement.zh: 下方电路的负载需要通过特性阻抗为 $Z_{0T}$ 的四分之一波长变换器，以及一段长度为 $d$、特性阻抗为 $Z_0$ 的传输线，匹配到 $Z_0=50\Omega$ 的馈线。长度为 $d$ 的传输线速度因子为 $0.85$，线上信号的频率为 $f=100\,\mathrm{MHz}=100\times10^6\,\mathrm{Hz}$。
statement.en: The load in the circuit below is to be matched to a $Z_0=50\Omega$ feedline using a quarter-wave transformer of characteristic impedance $Z_{0T}$ and a length of transmission line $d$ of characteristic impedance $Z_0$. The velocity factor of the transmission line of length $d$ is $0.85$ and the frequency of the signal on the line is $f=100\,\mathrm{MHz}=100\times10^6\,\mathrm{Hz}$.

figureCaption.zh: 复刻原卷插图，保留原图的视角、结构与标注。
figureCaption.en: Recreated from the exam figure, preserving its perspective, geometry and labels.

label.en: Through-line rotation on a Smith chart

label.zh: 主线加四分之一波匹配

prompt.zh: 计算归一化负载阻抗，并在 Smith 图上标出。
prompt.en: Calculate the normalized load impedance. Plot it on the Smith chart.

text.zh: 先写归一化负载阻抗定义，参考阻抗为题设 $50\,\Omega$。
text.en: Begin with normalized load impedance referenced to the specified $50\,\Omega$.

text.zh: 把实部 $150\,\Omega$ 与虚部 $-j50\,\Omega$ 分别除以 $50\,\Omega$。
text.en: Divide the real $150\,\Omega$ and imaginary $-j50\,\Omega$ parts separately by $50\,\Omega$.

text.zh: 在 Smith 图上找 $r=3$ 圆与 $x=-1$ 弧的交点；负电抗位于下半图。
text.en: On the Smith chart intersect $r=3$ with $x=-1$; negative reactance lies in the lower half.

text.zh: 分母的交叉项相消，而分子的交叉项需要相加。把 $j^2=-1$ 单独代入，说明分子中的正 $1$ 从哪里来。
text.en: The denominator cross terms cancel, while the numerator cross terms must be combined. Substitute $j^2=-1$ explicitly to show the positive $1$ in the numerator.

text.zh: 用共轭数求反射系数坐标，后续实轴交点和旋转都沿同一个等模圆。
text.en: Use the conjugate to obtain the reflection-plane coordinate; subsequent real-axis intersections and rotations follow its magnitude circle.

text.zh: 标出的归一化负载阻抗如下。
text.en: The plotted normalized load impedance is:

prompt.zh: 长度为 $d$ 的传输线能够呈现的两种纯实数输入阻抗 $Z_{in,d}$ 是多少？在 Smith 图上展示过程。给出未归一化的阻抗。
prompt.en: What are the two values of purely real input impedance $Z_{in,d}$ that the transmission line of length $d$ could present? Show your work on the Smith chart. Give your impedances in unnormalized format.

text.zh: 先由反射系数反解归一化阻抗。纯实输入阻抗对应 Smith 图实轴上的 $\Gamma$。
text.en: Invert the reflection equation for normalized impedance. Purely real input impedance corresponds to real-axis $\Gamma$ on the Smith chart.

text.zh: 为说明阻抗反解式的来源，从反射系数的定义交叉相乘，再把含 $z$ 的项移到同一边并提取公因子。
text.en: Derive the inverse impedance relation by cross-multiplying the reflection definition, moving the terms containing $z$ to one side and factoring them.

text.zh: 无损线向源移动只改变相位，不改变 $\Gamma$ 的模；先由负载值求该圆的半径。
text.en: Moving toward the source on a lossless line changes phase but not magnitude. Calculate the circle radius from the load.

text.zh: 实轴上的两个交点为 $+\rho$ 与 $-\rho$；分别代入阻抗反解式。
text.en: The two real-axis intersections are $+\rho$ and $-\rho$. Substitute both into the impedance relation.

text.zh: 代入半径，得到两个无量纲电阻值，互为倒数。
text.en: Insert the radius to obtain reciprocal dimensionless resistances.

text.zh: 题目要求去归一化，分别乘回 $50\,\Omega$，而不是直接把图上刻度当欧姆。
text.en: The question asks for unnormalized values, so multiply each chart reading by $50\,\Omega$.

text.zh: 结果由给定复负载精确计算；官方图上的近似读数保留在核对说明中。
text.en: These values are computed from the exact stated load; the official chart estimates remain documented in the source note.

note.zh: 官方图读数约 $14.5\,\Omega$ 与 $170\,\Omega$，且把“$0.26\times50$”写成 14.5；该乘法本身不一致。本页由原负载精确计算，图上近似读数作为参考。
note.en: The official chart reads about $14.5\,\Omega$ and $170\,\Omega$ and writes “$0.26\times50=14.5$”, an inconsistent multiplication. Here the values are computed exactly from the given load.

prompt.zh: 从第 b) 问的两个 $Z_{in,d}$ 中任选一个。传输线长度 $d$ 应为多少米，才能呈现所选的输入阻抗 $Z_{in,d}$？在 Smith 图上展示过程。
prompt.en: Choose one of the two values of $Z_{in,d}$ from part b). How long $d$ (in meters) must the transmission line be to present your chosen input impedance $Z_{in,d}$? Show your work on the Smith chart.

text.zh: 先写波长与反射系数沿线传播关系；向源移动 $d$ 使 $\Gamma$ 顺时针旋转 $4\pi d/\lambda$。
text.en: Begin with wavelength and reflection propagation. Moving $d$ toward the source rotates $\Gamma$ clockwise by $4\pi d/\lambda$.

text.zh: 代入速度因子和频率，求出将电长度换成米所需的波长。
text.en: Substitute velocity factor and frequency for the wavelength needed to convert electrical length to meters.

text.zh: 由 $\Gamma_L=(9-2j)/17$ 求初始相位，使用弧度制。
text.en: Find the initial phase from $\Gamma_L=(9-2j)/17$, in radians.

text.zh: 若选较小实电阻，目标是 $\Gamma=-\rho$，即相位 $-\pi$。列出旋转角方程并解 $d$。
text.en: For the smaller real resistance target $\Gamma=-\rho$, with phase $-\pi$. Write the rotation equation and solve for $d$.

text.zh: 将第一分支电长度乘波长；另一实轴交点比它多转半圈，对应再加 $\lambda/4$。
text.en: Multiply the first electrical length by $\lambda$. Reaching the other real-axis intersection requires another half-turn, adding $\lambda/4$.

text.zh: 第二分支也换成米。两个方案均可，后续变换线阻抗必须与所选分支配套。
text.en: Convert the second branch to meters as well. Either works, but the subsequent transformer impedance must use the matching branch.

text.zh: 列出两组电阻与长度的对应关系。
text.en: State the resistance–length pairing for both branches.

figureCaption.zh: 从复负载沿等反射系数模圆顺时针旋转，到达两个实轴交点。
figureCaption.en: Clockwise rotation from the complex load along its constant-reflection-magnitude circle to both real-axis intersections.

prompt.zh: 对第 c) 问选取的情况，求将负载网络匹配到 $Z_0=50\Omega$ 馈线所需的四分之一波长变换器特性阻抗 $Z_{0T}$。
prompt.en: For the case you chose in part c), find the characteristic impedance $Z_{0T}$ of the quarter-wave transformer that matches the load network to the $Z_0=50\Omega$ feedline.

text.zh: 先写原表四分之一波长变换公式；变换线的负载是前段线路呈现的纯电阻。
text.en: Begin with the crib quarter-wave equation; the transformer load is the real input resistance presented by the preceding line.

text.zh: 要求变换线向馈线呈现 $50\,\Omega$，先移项得到平方根公式。
text.en: Require a $50\,\Omega$ input to the feedline and rearrange to obtain the square-root formula.

text.zh: 若 c) 选择较小电阻分支，代入 $14.8371295\,\Omega$。
text.en: For the smaller-resistance branch in c), insert $14.8371295\,\Omega$.

text.zh: 若选择较大电阻分支，必须相应改用 $168.4962038\,\Omega$。
text.en: For the larger-resistance branch, use its corresponding $168.4962038\,\Omega$.

text.zh: 任选一组即可；将 $Z_{0T}^2$ 除以对应电阻会恢复 $50\,\Omega$，验证馈线匹配。
text.en: Either branch works. Dividing $Z_{0T}^2$ by its corresponding resistance returns $50\,\Omega$ and verifies the feedline match.

prompt.zh:
传输线和负载与馈线匹配后，发生器会在稳态下向负载传输最大功率。系统中哪些位置仍会发生反射？圈出所有适用项。

a. 馈线与 $L=\lambda/4$ 传输线输入端的界面。
b. $L=\lambda/4$ 传输线与长度为 $d$ 的传输线输入端的界面。
c. 长度为 $d$ 的传输线与负载 $Z_L$ 的界面。
d. 由于馈线已与负载匹配，系统任何位置都不会发生反射。
prompt.en:
Once the transmission line and load are matched to the feedline, maximum power will be transferred from the generator to the load in steady state. Where do reflections still occur in the system?
Circle all that apply.

a. At the interface between the feedline and the input to the $L=\lambda/4$ line.
b. At the interface between the $L=\lambda/4$ line and the input to the line of length $d$.
c. At the interface between the line of length $d$ and the load $Z_L$.
d. No reflections occur anywhere in the system since the feedline is matched to the load.

text.zh: 先写局部界面反射公式。这里比较界面两侧的行波特性阻抗；它与整个网络的净输入反射不是同一量。
text.en: Begin with local interface reflection. Compare traveling-wave characteristic impedances on the two sides; this differs from the net input reflection of the whole network.

text.zh: 选项 a：$50\,\Omega$ 馈线接到 $Z_{0T}$ 的变换线，两侧特性阻抗不同，因此存在局部反射。
text.en: Option a: the $50\,\Omega$ feedline meets the $Z_{0T}$ transformer. The different characteristic impedances give a local reflection.

text.zh: 选项 b：变换线接回 $50\,\Omega$ 主线，阻抗差也非零。
text.en: Option b: the transformer meets the $50\,\Omega$ main line, again with a nonzero impedance step.

text.zh: 选项 c：主线接到 $150-j50\,\Omega$ 的复负载，也仍然存在负载反射。
text.en: Option c: the main line meets the complex load $150-j50\,\Omega$ and still has load reflection.

text.zh: 整体匹配表示多次反射返回馈线的相量恰好抵消，使净输入反射为零；不能据此删掉 a 的局部反射。
text.en: Overall matching means the multiple reflected phasors returning into the feedline cancel, giving zero net input reflection; it does not remove the local reflection at $a$.

text.zh: 所以按标准答案的“哪些界面有反射”问法，选 a、b、c，选项 d 不成立。
text.en: Thus, for the official question about interfaces with reflections, select a, b and c; option d is false.

answerText.zh: 选 a、b、c。三个阻抗突变处都有局部反射；整体匹配使这些返回馈线的反射相量抵消，净输入反射为零。
answerText.en: Select a, b and c. Each impedance discontinuity has a local reflection; overall matching cancels the returning reflected phasors at the feedline, giving zero net input reflection.

concept.zh: 本题考查先用主线消去复负载的虚部，再用四分之一波长变换器完成匹配。
concept.en: This problem first transforms a complex load to a real impedance, then completes the match with a quarter-wave transformer.

known.zh: $Z_L=(150-j50)\,\Omega$、$Z_0=50\,\Omega$，长度为 $d$ 的线速度因子为 $0.85$，工作频率为 $100\,\mathrm{MHz}$。
known.en: The load is $Z_L=(150-j50)\,\Omega$ and the feedline is $50\,\Omega$. The section of length $d$ has velocity factor $0.85$ at $100\,\mathrm{MHz}$.

goal.zh: 在 Smith 图上找出两种纯实输入阻抗，选一支求实际线长与变换器阻抗，并判断系统内部哪些界面仍有反射。
goal.en: Find the two real input impedances on the Smith chart, choose a branch for physical length and transformer impedance, and identify interfaces where reflections remain.

approach.zh: 先沿负载的等反射系数圆找到实轴交点，再把图上的波长读数换成米。四分之一波变换器负责第二次阻抗变换；馈线匹配并不等于内部每个界面都匹配。
approach.en: Find the real-axis crossings on the load's constant-reflection circle and convert wavelength readings to meters. The quarter-wave section performs the second transformation; a matched feedline does not imply that every internal interface is matched.
